name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Strawberry Shortcake
description: An exclusive drop you don’t want to miss. Limited Edition Strawberry Shortcake BITEZ layer luscious, ripe strawberry with creamy vanilla cake for a rich, dessert-inspired flavor that tastes pure indulgence. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). This limited release won’t last—when it’s gone, it’s gone.
